name: 415 · RFC Guard · REAL SAP · System Readiness Check

parameters.content:
## R/3, ECC and S/4HANA readiness

This checks transport, authentication, backend identity and advertised business aliases. It does not replace SE37 verification or STAUTHTRACE. Older R/3 releases without BAPI_USER_GETLIST require the governed custom-RFC or snapshot route.

Keep inactive and unpublished.
